Each static role is a separate complete export. Multi-view technical boards are allowed where commissioned; do not count one contact sheet or duplicate export as several roles.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Read every numerical label and plotted encoding against 03-national-data.en.md and 04-regional-data.en.md, preserving observation year, geography, measure and unit. The 2025 overview and portrait must each contain total 1043.46; Bus 365.66 and 35.04%; Urban rail 332.24 and 31.84%; Taxi 344.82 and 33.05%; Ferry 0.74 and 0.07%. The 2024 structure variants, where delivered, must each contain total 1067.97; Bus 386.70 and 36.21%; Urban rail 322.09 and 30.16%; Taxi 358.41 and 33.56%; Ferry 0.77 and 0.07%. The combined change chart must include both annual totals and all four modes for both years, plus official 2025 growth for total -2.3%, Bus -5.5%, Urban rail 3.2%, Taxi -3.8% and Ferry -3.7%. Each expanded change chart must contain its named mode's two annual volumes and official 2025 rate. Regional records must match the supplied totals and four shares: Shanghai 592330, 17.98/63.58/17.99/0.45%; Jiangsu 570913, 34.58/38.50/26.88/0.05%; Fujian 315766, 43.21/18.13/37.85/0.81%; Hubei 434582, 40.32/33.89/25.66/0.14%; Guangdong 1244871, 24.68/52.18/23.04/0.10%; Chongqing 484764, 40.92/29.81/29.24/0.04%, in Bus/Urban rail/Taxi/Ferry order. Additional printed regional volumes or growth must also match the attachment. Thousands separators and typographic layout may vary; wrong records, missing required series, altered values or misleading plotted magnitudes fail.

Inspect every chart, including charts embedded in direction boards. Each must have an informative title, an observation-year indication, a unit inside its chart area, a Ministry of Transport credit appropriate to 2024, 2025 or 2024–2025, mode names attached clearly to the represented series, and at least one specific annotation that helps interpret the data. Mixed volume, share and growth panels must identify their respective units. Annotation wording and placement may vary; a detached legend alone, a publication date substituted for the observation year, missing units or generic decorative text do not satisfy these requirements.

Where a mode appears, its encoded color must follow Bus orange #E69F00, Urban rail blue #0072B2, Taxi pink #CC79A7 and Ferry green #009E73. Allow ordinary rendering and antialiasing differences, but reject swapped or materially changed assignments. Mode identities must remain unambiguous when color is removed because direct labels remain readable. Every displayed volume or share axis must begin at zero; axis-free representations are permitted if their magnitudes remain truthful. Every signed growth panel must visibly identify zero and distinguish positive from negative values.

The 2024 and 2025 reported-volume snapshots must be distinct from the official 2025 percentage-growth panel, with labels explaining their different statistical bases. Include a concise explanation that published annual volumes are rounded and official growth uses a comparable basis. The combined chart and expanded Ferry chart, when present, must identify -3.7% as the official 2025 Ferry rate. A separately explained arithmetic result of -3.9% may appear, but it must never replace or be confused with official growth. Panel arrangement may vary; merged measures, an unlabeled basis or recalculated growth presented as official fail.

Require Shanghai/Jiangsu/Fujian on the coastal chart and Hubei/Guangdong/Chongqing on the river chart. Each must identify 2024 province-level records, give every regional total in 10,000 passenger trips and display each region's four mode shares in percent. Both must provide usable navigation to the national overview. Order and visual arrangement may vary; incorrect membership, administrative level, units, missing mode shares or broken navigation fail.

Assess the depicted physical page envelope against carrier-dimensions.png and the stated carriers: landscape overviews correspond to 420 × 280 mm boards and portrait stories to 200 × 300 mm leaflets. Their content must respect a 10 mm inset on every edge, evaluated proportionally to the physical carrier rather than by an exact raster pixel count. Uniform image scaling is allowed; a wrong physical page proportion or content intruding into the required inner margin fails.

Every image must visibly include the supplied reading-room feature as a recognizable vignette with three adjacent rounded arches and a circular opening centered above the middle arch. Scale, position and illustrative simplification may vary while preserving the reference architecture and its pale stone surround and dark bronze frames where material is represented. A missing vignette, changed arch count or missing or displaced upper opening fails.

The three boards must demonstrate distinguishable region-led, time-led and mode-led reading structures in their assigned roles. Each must use the 2025 national total 1043.46 and an identifiable 2024 Shanghai record supported by the regional table. Evidence must be visible in hierarchy and reading order, beyond simply changing a title. Graphic treatments may vary; duplicated structures, missing shared test data or incorrect Shanghai facts fail.

The note must choose exactly one of the three delivered directions, give it an identifiable name, and explain how a reader proceeds from national overview through the relevant story to regional comparison. The chosen name and described structure must correspond to the boards; no particular naming style is required. The document must also retain the recognizable three-arch window with its upper circular opening. An ambiguous choice, an unexplained sequence, a choice unrelated to the boards or a missing location vignette fails.

Require a usable inventory covering every chart planned for the applicable tier, with its data columns, chart type, units, carrier, printed labels and source credit. Record 1043.46, 100 million passenger trips and Ministry of Transport | 2025 together as recurring national facts. The planned organization must develop the selected reading direction. All stated numbers and field definitions must agree with the supplied tables, and the document must contain the recognizable reference window vignette. Inventory formatting may vary; missing chart variants, absent inventory fields, incorrect recurring facts, contradictory reading order or a missing vignette fail.

Require the 2025 total 1043.46, its unit 100 million passenger trips, Ministry of Transport | 2025, and mode shares Bus 35.04%, Urban rail 31.84%, Taxi 33.05% and Ferry 0.07%. Include three distinct numerical findings supported by the attachments. Give concise explanations of repeat passenger trips, street-hail and ride-hail Taxi coverage, province-level regional geography, shares using the reported total and source rounding; distinguish comparable growth from annual volume arithmetic whenever discussed. Follow the selected reading sequence and repeat the abstract's national facts accurately. Any embedded charts must carry the required titles, years, units, credits, direct labels, annotations, fixed colors and zero references. Verify the fixed publication wording, recognizable window vignette, A4 carrier and 10 mm inner margins. Prose and layout may vary; missing required information, wrong data or contradictory definitions fail.

Explain that passenger trips count repeated uses rather than unique people; Taxi includes street-hail and ride-hail; the six regional records are province-level units including provinces and municipalities; and share = mode volume / reported total × 100. Explain independently rounded source totals and components, two-decimal shares and possible sums slightly different from 100%. Distinguish annual volume snapshots from official comparable-basis growth and retain -3.7% when presenting the official 2025 Ferry rate. Preserve the selected reading sequence, fixed publication wording and recognizable window vignette. Equivalent plain-language explanations are acceptable; denominator substitution, unique-person claims, city-level framing or missing required explanations fail.

Require at least eight pages, with the chosen direction's name on page one. The editorial progression must present the three directions before the selection and subsequent development, then follow the chosen national-to-regional reading sequence. Repeat 1043.46, 100 million passenger trips, Ministry of Transport | 2025 and Urban rail share 31.84%. Repeat the scope explanations about multiple trips, both Taxi services, province-level geography, reported-total shares, rounding and comparable growth. Distinguish annual snapshots from official growth and preserve official Ferry growth -3.7%. All stated or reproduced data must match the attachments; every chart must retain its title, observation year, in-chart unit, credit, labels, annotation, fixed colors and applicable zero reference. Include the fixed publication wording and recognizable window vignette. Pagination and prose may vary; insufficient pages, a missing first-page direction name, omitted explanations or inconsistent facts fail.

The presentation must visibly reuse recognizable material from every listed source role, including frames from the delivered video. Scaling, cropping and page composition are allowed when the original chart or document content remains identifiable and legible. A text-only mention of an earlier file, generic replacement artwork, unreadable thumbnails or omission of any listed source fails.

Review the complete 10-second video for recognizable reuse of the selected 2025 national overview and development of the chosen reading direction. It must explain total 1043.46 in 100 million passenger trips and Urban rail share 31.84%, and visibly retain Ministry of Transport | 2025. During the final three seconds, the total, unit, source credit and rail share must remain together and legible without interruption. Verify all numerical claims against the attachments, preserve chart titles, observation years, units, source credits, direct labels, reading annotations, fixed colors and applicable zero references, and include the fixed publication name, descriptor and recognizable window vignette. Animation and narration may vary; wrong facts, missing source reuse, an incomplete closing hold or missing identity elements fail.
